# Annotation fixture attribution

`hoi_val_unseen_obj_unseen_act_one.json` is the first unchanged episode from
`bongard_hoi_release/bongard_hoi_val_unseen_obj_unseen_act.json` in the official
[Bongard-HOI annotation archive](https://zenodo.org/records/7079175), retrieved
2026-10-18 using bytes0–1048575 of the public TAR. Formatting was changed to
indented JSON; the episode contents were not relabeled.

Dataset authors: Huaizu Jiang, Xiaojian Ma, Weili Nie, Zhiding Yu, Yuke Zhu and
Anima Anandkumar. Citation: *Bongard-HOI: Benchmarking Few-Shot Visual Reasoning
for Human-Object Interactions*, CVPR2022. The Zenodo dataset record declares
[CC BY4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

This is annotation data, not copied NVIDIA loader code. No source photographs
are included. The separate NVIDIA source-code license does not apply to this
independently written parser. Other tests construct tiny images solely to check
loading, privacy boundaries and failure cases; those are not benchmark results.
